words.definition: to stop what you are doing for a short time

words.definition: to give up something valuable to help someone else

words.definition: suitable or right for a particular situation or person

words.definition: to run after someone or something in order to catch them
words.sentence: Playful kittens love to chase a colorful yarn ball indoors.
words.speaker: Liam

words.definition: to have earned something because of your good qualities or actions
words.sentence: After hours of hard work, you deserve a healthy snack.
